what: the author's review decisions on the unregistered supplement triage, approved in chat on 23 October 2026; rule ids, rule texts in the reviewer's words, choices, card calls and the audit draw; no quotation from any source

rules.P1: a sample-size or assay signature unique to one dictionary row
rules.P2: case and control counts equal to those of exactly one release
rules.P3: an OpenGWAS id resolved through the stored OpenGWAS metadata
rules.P4: a GWAS Catalog accession found in the stored Catalog listing of a dictionary publication
rules.P5: UKB-PPP with per-protein N at or below 34,557, or the words discovery cohort, 35k, or 35,571, codes as UKB-PPP discovery
rules.P6: a consortium or author name with a description codes to the dictionary's single row of that name
rules.P7: obvious typos are read through; cases so far 35,553 for 35,559 and 79,198 for 79,148

review_rules.R1: UKB-PPP with only the project total (54,219 or 54,306), or anything else that does not fix the subset, stays unresolved
review_rules.R2: where one row covers claims from different sources, each claim gets the release its own protein or outcome used; a source with no dictionary row is coded dataset_absent_from_dictionary; a claim whose source is not shown stays unresolved
review_rules.R3: for the Zheng 2020 compiled set, where the supplement names the original study per protein, code that original study; code the Zheng 2020 row only when no original study is named; applies to practical rows coded as Zheng too
review_rules.R4: accept a near-match differing by at most 0.1% when no other release is closer; a subset of one study's data (European-only Okada 2014, the CKDGen European subset, Aragam's European primary analysis) codes as that study's row
review_rules.R5: 40657364 stays unresolved: its table cell contradicts itself

card_calls.41350740: split per R2: the IDUA claim is absent from the dictionary; the other claims go to Ferkingstad 2021
card_calls.41286868: split per R2: TIE1, ERAP2, IL27RA and TNFRSF6B go to Sun 2018; the other seven claims stay unresolved

audit.draw: random.Random(20261046).sample over the resolved rows that are not reversals, sorted by row_id, 15 rows
